about_item: Flickering Flame Halloween Decorations: IkeeRuic halloween lights outdoor cast a scary purple glow like flickering flame, a safe alternative to the real “flame”. Solar halloween lights are perfect halloween decorations outdoor for yard, pathway, garden, patio, porch, fence, making your halloween yard decorations stand out in the community.

Solar Powered & Halloween Decor: Equipped with high-efficiency solar panel, outdoor halloween lights can work up 4-6 hours in winter after fully charged. Purple halloween lights provides ghostly and scary outside halloween decorations for party, camping and BBQ, which is a delightful addition to outdoor halloween decor.

Outdoor Halloween Decorations: No wires and tools needed, halloween solar lights outdoor are easy to install. Just connect the poles and spikes into the ground where there is direct sunshine. Please turn on the switch before first use, then solar powered halloween lights can light up from dusk to dawn automatically.

Waterproof Halloween Outdoor Decor: Halloween outdoor lights are made of high-quality ABS plastics, designed to withstand most of weather for halloween decor. No worries about rain, snow, frost and low-temperature. Please notice that weather and winter will affect charging efficiency.

Cute Torches & Warm Tips: The size of halloween torch lights are 2.9*20.5 inch with pole and spike, lovely and cute for Halloween outdoor decorations. Since it is powered by solar energy, the actual working time is affected by the installation location and the weather conditions. Firstly receiving package, please turn on the switch and put under direct sunlight.

summary.text: Customers find these solar lights an excellent addition to Halloween decorations, appreciating their purple color and flickering flame-like appearance. The lighting quality and reliability receive mixed feedback - while some find them bright and working well throughout October, others report they dim quickly and stop working after a week. Moreover, the value for money is debated, with some considering them a great buy for the price while others say they're not worth the cost. Additionally, the product's lifespan is negative, with customers reporting they only last two days.
